description: This file defines interfaces related to system information and subsystems, including security, network, location, and device identification, for a plugin host in a media framework.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing software build and version information.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface for accessing and managing various system subsystems such as security, network, location, etc.

classes.name: ISubSystem::INotification
classes.description: Interface for notifications about subsystem updates.

classes.name: ISubSystem::IDecryption
classes.description: Interface for decryption status and info.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree version.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Notification callback indicating a subsystem update.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).

methods.name: TimeSync
methods.description: Returns the current time synchronization value.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to next string in provisioning or decryption list.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves to previous string in provisioning or decryption list.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns number of items in provisioning or decryption list.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns current string in provisioning or decryption list.
